task.description:
REWORK ITERATION 1 (targeted bug fix, found by TEST-DESIGNER at Step 3 per Unblock-Everything, not a design or scope defect -- your original Step 2a implementation otherwise PASSED SECURITY-REVIEWER and REVIEWER cleanly and neither needs to be redone for unrelated reasons). Fix ONLY this: lib/letflow/service_catalog/version.ex's archive_changeset/1 applies validate_required/2 to request_schema, response_schema, and retry_policy -- these are legitimately NULLABLE fields (confirm by reading lib/letflow/service_catalog/entry.ex's own schema/changeset treatment of these same three fields, which correctly does NOT require them). This breaks publish/3 end-to-end whenever those optional fields are unset, which is the common case -- 6 of TEST-DESIGNER's new tests fail against current code for exactly this one reason (test/letflow/service_catalog_test.exs, test/letflow/engine_pin_resolver_catalog_test.exs, test/letflow/routers/admin_services_publish_retire_test.exs). Fix: remove request_schema/response_schema/retry_policy from archive_changeset/1's validate_required/2 list, keeping only whatever fields are genuinely required for an archive row (mirror entry.ex's own required-field list for parity, since the archive row is a snapshot of an Entry). ALSO fix the MINOR finding TEST-DESIGNER reported: chk_service_catalog_version_length (or equivalent length constraint) is unreachable, masked by the underlying column's varchar(255) type -- either remove the dead CHECK constraint or widen the column so the constraint is reachable; your call, state which and why in a comment.

Do not touch anything else -- this is a narrow, targeted fix. After fixing, run `mix compile --warnings-as-errors`, `mix format --check-formatted`, and the three test files TEST-DESIGNER wrote (`mix test test/letflow/service_catalog_test.exs test/letflow/engine_pin_resolver_catalog_test.exs test/letflow/routers/admin_services_publish_retire_test.exs`) yourself and quote real output confirming all previously-failing tests now pass. Complete the handoff with your genuine PASS/FAIL, commit and push (explicit filenames, never -A) to origin feature/WF02-REQ373-20260921 before ending your turn. next_action: 'Route to SECURITY-REVIEWER and REVIEWER for a targeted re-gate of this specific fix, then TEST-DESIGN-VALIDATOR'.
acceptance_criteria: the previously-failing 6 tests now pass, real output quoted
chk_service_catalog_version_length reachability issue resolved (constraint removed or column widened, stated explicitly)
